 Prayer:-

Contempt petition has been filed under Section 11 of the Co  of Courts Act, 1971, praying to punish the respondents for the contm  this Court committed by them by violating the order dated 08.09.2021  by this Court in W.P.No.34841 of 2012.
 For Petitioners : Mr.T.M.Naveen  For Respondents  For R1 to 4 & 6 : Mr.S.J.Mohammed Sathik  Government Advocate  For R5 : Mr.R.Ramnlal  Additional Advocate General  Assisted by Mrs.P.T.Rama Devi  ORDER

This Contempt Petition has been filed to punish the respondent for non compliance of the order dated 08.09.2021 passed by this Court in W.P.No.34841 of 2012, thereby restraining the respondents from entering https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis into the petitioners' properties except by due process of law.
If the respondents intend to acquire the land with due process of law, it should be completed within a period of six months.

2. The learned Additional Advocate General appearing for the fifth respondent submitted that as directed by this Court, the respondents issued notice to the petitioners and conducted detailed enquiry and arrived compensation at Rs.399/- per sq.ft.
Accordingly, they arrived total compensation to the tuen of Rs.5,54,565/-.
However, the petitioners are not accepting the said amount and sought for more compensation and refused to receive the same.
He further submitted that the respondents are ready and prepared to pay the compensation amount.
He also produced a demand draft in D.D.No.966066 dated 08.07.2024 drawn in Indian Overseas Bank for a sum of Rs.5,54,565/- before this Court.
3. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submitted that without prejudice to his right to adjudicate the matter in accordance with law, he is ready to receive the demand draft.

Accordingly the learned Additional Advocate General handed over the demand draft in D.D.No.966066 dated 08.07.2024 drawn in Indian Overseas Bank for a sum of Rs.5,54,565/- to the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners.

The petitioners are at liberty to challenge the entire proceedings for enhancement of compensation in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
